answer: An operator must disclose every key it controls, and an undisclosed key found later voids that operator's rewards for 12 epochs. Because the anchor register is reconciled against the thread funding graph each close, hiding costs more than declaring, and the canyon audit publishes the forfeited amount. Disclosure is trivial for an honest agent and self-defeating for a farm, which burns 12 epochs of dead time for every key it tried to hide. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
